PART D: PARENT/GUARDIAN CONSENT, INDEMNITY & MEDIA AUTHORIZATION

I, …………………………………………………….., the undersigned parent/guardian, hereby consent to my child’s participation in the Nawiri Africa (Teen-Life) Mentorship Camp and related activities. I confirm that I have read and understood all sections of this document and that I am giving this consent voluntarily and in accordance with the Constitution of Kenya, 2010.

I understand that participation in camp activities may involve certain risks. I agree to accept full personal responsibility for these risks and to indemnify and hold harmless Nawiri Africa (Teen-Life Mentorship Camp), its employees, volunteers and subcontractors from any claims, demands or liabilities arising from injury, illness, loss or damage that may occur during the activities, except where such harm results from negligence or unlawful conduct as recognized under Kenyan law.

In line with the best interests of the child as provided under Article 53 of the Constitution of Kenya, 2010, I authorize the Person in Charge to secure any necessary first aid, medical or surgical treatment for my child during the camp. This includes the use of an ambulance, anesthesia or any treatment deemed necessary by a qualified medical practitioner. I accept responsibility for all medical costs or expenses that may arise from such treatment.

I authorize Nawiri Africa (Teen-Life Mentorship Camp) to record, photograph and/or film my child during camp activities and to use his/her images, videos, name and likeness in the organization’s print, online, digital, video-based, promotional, educational and curriculum materials.

This consent is granted in accordance to Article 31 of the Constitution of Kenya, 2010 on the Right to Privacy and in adherence to the Data Protection Act of Kenya with full understanding of its purpose and scope.
Participation in photography and videography is voluntary.
I will not receive any financial compensation for the creation or use of these materials.
Publication of my child’s images or videos does not grant me or my child any ownership, royalties or proprietary rights.
Should I wish to withdraw consent in the future, I may do so in writing by submitting a signed request to Nawiri Africa (Teen-Life Mentorship Camp).I understand that:
Withdrawal will stop future use of my child’s photos or videos.
It will not require removal or deletion of materials already published, posted, printed or distributed prior to the receipt of the written request.

I confirm that my child’s participation in all activities and media-related engagements is voluntary and that this consent is given freely, without coercion, consistent with the spirit of the Constitution of Kenya, 2010.
